items.text: HELL FREEZES OVER in DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations, an all-new campaign expansion that unleashes a brutal new chapter of the Slayer’s saga.

Wounded and betrayed, the Slayer is thrust into a merciless purgatory only escapable by confronting haunting truths and forging new strength with the help of a mysterious ally. He must ascend from the prison of his mind and fight an abomination of the gods to set his followers on the path to freedom.

Featuring new levels with deeper puzzles, new demons, and new mysteries, Revelations opens up a whole new dimension of combat. The all-new deadly Chain Spear offers returning slayers a uniquely satisfying combat system – one that rewards mastery with enhanced power and mobility.

On PC, all upscaling technologies (DLSS, FSR, and XeSS) now support dynamic resolution scaling, allowing players to select higher upscaling quality settings while maintaining strong frame rates during demanding combat scenarios
Upgraded to DLSS 4.5, featuring an enhanced upscaling model and support for 5x and 6x Frame Generation modes on compatible GPUs
[p align="start"]Issue: Game crashes while Switching from Fullscreen to Borderless Windowed display modes while OBS is running
Resolution: Close OBS while switching display modes
[p align="start"]Issue: I have an Intel GPU with 8GB of dedicated VRAM or more. Can I play DOOM: The Dark Ages or DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations?
Resolution: While Intel GPUs are not officially supported, players with intel GPUs that have 8GB of dedicated VRAM should be able to play the game using driver version 32.0.101.8860
[p align="start"]Issue: I have a NVIDIA GPU - which driver should I use to play DOOM: The Dark Ages or DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations?
Resolution: Users with NVIDIA GPUs should install the 610.74 WHQL driver or later
[p align="start"]Issue: I have an AMD GPU - which driver should I use to play DOOM: The Dark Ages or DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations?
Resolution: Users with AMD GPUs should install the Adrenalin Edition 22.6.1 driver or later
[p align="start"]Issue: The game crashes while running on AMD GPUs with recent driver updates
Resolution: Reinstall drivers and select the ‘factory reset’ option on install
[p align="start"]Issue: The game exhibits poor performance on MSI Claw devices and other Intel Panther Lake processors
Resolution: Claw devices and Panther Lake processors are not currently supported
[p align="start"]Issue: Main Menu music plays during combat in the Ripatorium after restarting in some circumstances
Resolution: Players can use the Jukebox to reset the music if this issue occurs
[p align="start"]Issue: Chain Spear and Shield Saw abilities stop responding after performing Chain Spear attacks while the Player's primary weapon runs out of ammo
Resolution: Change weapons, use a melee attack, or load the most recent checkpoint to resolve this issue
[p align="start"]Issue: Chain Spear and Shield Saw abilities stop responding after interacting with a Hollow Shrine
Resolution: Avoid using dash and slash abilities in quick succession immediately before interacting with Hollow Shrines. Loading the most recent checkpoint will resolve this issue
[p align="start"]Issue: Master Arenas may not spawn enemies when successfully repeating multiple times
Resolution: Load the previous checkpoint to restore enemy spawns
[p align="start"]Issue: Master Slayer Trial timer display falls out of sync when Game Speed setting is modified
Resolution: Players can restore the Game Speed to default to resolve this issue
Issue: After receiving the Chain Spear in Revelations, during the Tutorial I’m seeing “??” for inputs in the HUD

Resolution: Go to: Menu -> Settings -> Inputs and press the corresponding Reset to Default button at the bottom of the command bar ("V" on PC, "L3" on XBOX & PlayStation) and then confirm by hitting the "Yes" button when prompted to reset the Slayer Controls

Update 3 for DOOM: The Dark Ages introduces Ripatorium 2.0, offering additional Encounter Presets, deeper customization options, additional jukebox tracks and the ability to share your custom encounters on a per-round basis via Passcode sharing.

[p align="start"]This update also includes Campaign quality-of-life updates such as the Brink of Death feature now selectable between Normal and Hard settings via the Difficulty tab, plus player-requested updates including bindable inputs for your active Melee Weapon and Shield Rune.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053548/709752e9d52190a4aa4cb59d91762ebfa2206708.jpg"]
[p align="start"]We’ve added even more ways to customize the Ripatorium arena mode, including the ability to share and load presets from each round via our Passcode sharing*.
The Ripatorium is now round-based, with players customizing a selection of enemies they will face for up to five rounds
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053548/32dedfa00de67f8c0918866c3eba126acc582328.jpg"]
Each Ripatorium round can have unique settings and up to 10 respawn waves
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053548/cacf023d72f1753b5b16dedefa5b5fc688cbda36.jpg"]
In the Settings menu, we've added new options for Time Limit
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053548/714662a2a62cc7ef61bfad1f33d25ee02598dc41.jpg"]
Each round also features a unique Passcode (highlighted in the image below) that allows you to share your custom Ripatorium round and all its settings with other players
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053548/2e495be0b74b9b03303d3abff7c7165ca848d585.jpg"]
[p align="start"]*Please note Ripatorium Passcode sharing is in Beta
To play someone else's Ripatorium encounter, select the corresponding round and press the newly added "Enter New Passcode" input at the bottom of the screen
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053548/2a6b2af8d72aa916a729fca22c3db2ef19d9f82f.jpg"]
[p align="start"]There are also new Encounter Presets to choose from: Medium, Challenging and Sadistic
Note: You can enable these Encounter Presets in conjunction with any Difficulty Level
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053548/34577290231f9b8c161b14e0370abacde78625b4.jpg"]
[p align="start"]What are the "Preset Incoming" Encounters? (Highlighted in the image below)

We're looking to collect the best custom encounters so that we can curate some community-made presets! Be sure to tag @doom on social with your unique round Passcodes for your best full encounter setups! In time, these will be added in-game via an Active Tunable update (without requiring a client update)

Developer Note: The Dark Ages (and Eternal) was designed from the start to allow players the chance to fight their way back from a near death experience - this system is known as the Brink of Death. When your health is low, by design, you are at your most alert and engaged. We’ve re-tuned this system’s values to settings closer to launch, enhancing this aspect of the combat.

releases.displayName: June 2025 PC Update | Path Tracing (select NVIDIA GPUs) + Benchmark Mode

items.text: This June 2025 PC Update is exclusive to the PC versions of the game. It adds Path Tracing support with Ray Reconstruction for select NVIDIA GPUs. Also included in this update is a brand-new Benchmark Mode that lets PC gamers measure their system’s performance on a variety of settings. Additionally, this update resolves some known issues present in the previous version of the game.
Path Tracing Support with DLSS Ray Reconstruction

Path Tracing is officially supported on the range of NVIDIA GPUs, video settings and system requirements noted in the table below. Path Tracing, when combined with DLSS Ray Reconstruction adds accurate light bounce modeling, bringing new detail into view on material surfaces and reflections at a level previously not possible in a DOOM game.

[img src="https://images.mweb.bethesda.net/_images/DoomTheDarkAges_PathTracingHardwareReq_1920x1080-03.jpg?fx=50&fy=50&f=jpg&h=1080&w=1920&s=PGraGhwNo5mLnKsWSZpVNW6Sl5QTUguolxi3EPZ10rI"]Required drivers: NVIDIA 576.75 or higher

To enable Path Tracing, go to the Video Settings menu, and scroll down to the Path Tracing section and set Path Tracing to On. To enable Ray Reconstruction, select it as the Denoiser in the Path Tracing section of the Video Settings menu. Make sure to apply your settings changes before returning to gameplay.
While users on other supported GPU models are free to attempt to run the game with Path Tracing enabled at lower settings, 60 FPS, correct visuals and game stability are not assured when doing so.
Click here for more information from NVIDIA regarding Path Tracing and the Ray Reconstruction in DOOM: The Dark Ages

Benchmark mode creates a consistent, nearly deterministic path through a section of select DOOM: The Dark Ages levels to that players can see how their systems perform under a variety of video settings. Using this mode players can see how far they can push their system performance.
To access Benchmark Mode, go to the Extras section of the Main Menu and select Benchmark Mode. From here, you can select and run any of the following Benchmark Levels:

[img src="https://images.mweb.bethesda.net/_images/image%20(54).png?fx=50&fy=50&f=jpg&h=640&w=772&s=GNUWeYC2-Ev543xefTz0xaVy2SWFRhH-5DPt6s4CMFk"]While running a Benchmark Level, graphs show FPS, total frame time, GPU and CPU frame time. Use the controls listed at the bottom of the screen to toggle graph metrics between FPS and milliseconds, and to toggle graph visibility on/off
[img src="https://images.mweb.bethesda.net/_images/TDA_Benchmark01.png?fx=50&fy=50&f=jpg&h=2160&w=3840&s=Ibi1x1wY9XlrLTMA2EMCXCqJfiWhA1Tt24Mp8tZmtbM"]
